evals.prompt: Create a financial spreadsheet with three sheets: 'Data', 'Analysis', 'Report'. Sheet 1 (Data): Add monthly revenue data for 12 months (Jan-Dec) ranging from $50k to $120k. Sheet 2 (Analysis): Calculate total revenue, average monthly, growth rate, and month-over-month percentage change using formulas (not hardcoded). Sheet 3 (Report): Create a summary showing: Total Annual Revenue, Average Monthly, Max Month, Min Month using VLOOKUP or reference formulas. Format with proper colors, headers, and number formatting (currency).
evals.expected_output: A .xlsx file with 3 sheets, dynamic formulas, and professional formatting

assertions.name: three_sheets_exist
assertions.description: Output file has exactly three sheets: Data, Analysis, Report

assertions.name: data_sheet_populated
assertions.description: Data sheet contains 12 rows of revenue data with proper headers

assertions.name: formulas_not_hardcoded
assertions.description: Analysis sheet uses formulas (SUM, AVERAGE, etc.) instead of hardcoded values

assertions.name: report_sheet_complete
assertions.description: Report sheet shows all 4 summary metrics with correct calculated values

assertions.name: proper_formatting
assertions.description: Currency formatting applied to all monetary values, headers formatted distinctly

evals.prompt: You have a messy CSV file with sales data: some rows have missing headers, several columns have inconsistent data (dates in MM/DD/YYYY and MM-DD-YY formats mixed), names have leading/trailing spaces, and some rows are duplicates. Clean this into a proper spreadsheet with: consistent headers, standardized date format (YYYY-MM-DD), trimmed text values, duplicates removed, and sorted by date. Export as .xlsx with proper column widths and frozen headers.
evals.expected_output: Cleaned .xlsx file with properly formatted data, no duplicates, consistent formatting

assertions.name: headers_consistent
assertions.description: All columns have clear, consistent headers

assertions.name: dates_standardized
assertions.description: All dates are in consistent YYYY-MM-DD format

assertions.name: duplicates_removed
assertions.description: No duplicate rows remain in the output

assertions.name: text_trimmed
assertions.description: No leading or trailing spaces in text values

assertions.name: data_sorted
assertions.description: Rows are sorted chronologically by date

evals.prompt: You have a spreadsheet with product sales data: ProductName, UnitPrice, QuantitySold, Discount%. Create new columns for: TotalPrice (UnitPrice × Quantity), DiscountAmount (TotalPrice × Discount%), FinalPrice (TotalPrice - DiscountAmount), Profit (FinalPrice × 0.35 margin). Use formulas so the calculations update if source data changes. Add a summary row at the bottom showing totals for all numeric columns.
evals.expected_output: .xlsx file with new calculated columns using formulas and summary totals

assertions.name: calculated_columns_added
assertions.description: All 4 new calculated columns are present (TotalPrice, DiscountAmount, FinalPrice, Profit)

assertions.name: formulas_used
assertions.description: Calculations use formulas, not hardcoded values

assertions.name: summary_row_present
assertions.description: Summary row with SUM formulas for totals is present at the bottom

assertions.name: mathematical_accuracy
assertions.description: Sample calculations verify correct math (e.g., 100 × 2 = 200 for TotalPrice)
